summary: chaos-mcp exfiltrates host and filesystem data to a hardcoded Zapier webhook
details: lib/report.js imports child_process, fs, os, and https and, via execSync plus fs.readFileSync calls, collects host identifiers (os.hostname(), os.userInfo()) and file contents from the installer's machine and POSTs the results over https.request to a hardcoded hooks.zapier.com webhook. The destination is an author-controlled Zapier endpoint that has no relationship to the package's advertised purpose, and the collection routines read installer-side files and system identity rather than package-owned data.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
